name: [UPDATE!] Survive a Plate
desc:
THE SPOOKY SEASON IS HERE!

Survive a Plate is a fast paced plate/minigame game. Try to survive multiple events with up to 16 players! Purchase or craft unique blocks to build a fortified base to survive longer.

💾 All data saves automaticly! 💾
🎲 55+ blocks to place or use! 🎲
⚡ 80+ unique events to survive! ⚡
